cues.en: Water's refreshing. I usually like to ensure the pH of the water is strictly seven. Sometimes eight if I'm feeling a little more alkaline. Anything six or below is a no go. I check the acidity with an electronic pH meter just to be sure. You want a nice crisp balanced flavor, so no Dasani.
cues.zh: 水喝起来真清爽。我一般会确保水的 pH 值严格保持在 7。有时候心情偏碱一点，也会喝 pH 值为 8 的水。低于 6 可不行。我会用电子 pH 计测一下酸度，确保万无一失。水喝起来要清冽、平衡，所以别喝 Dasani。

cues.en: I'd recommend Aquafina for a beginner's water if you must go bottled, but honestly, room temperature tap water through a filter is the way to go. Then you get all the minerals. Now glass shape is important. You can either go tall you can go wide. We call them verdes or hories, vertical or horizontal. I like to go with a horie because I really wanna see the water between sips. I think looking at it is half the pleasure. I also always do throat massages and exercises to make sure you get maximum travel velocity down the throat. What?
cues.zh: 要是非喝瓶装水，我建议新手喝 Aquafina。不过说实话，过滤后的常温自来水才是最佳选择，这样还能摄取到所有矿物质。杯子的形状也很重要，可以选高的，也可以选宽的。我们叫它们 verdes 和 hories，也就是竖口杯和横口杯。我喜欢横口杯，这样两口之间还能看到水。我觉得光是看着水，就已经是一半的享受了。我还总会做喉部按摩和练习，确保水能以最快速度通过喉咙。什么？
